description.value: Puerto Vallarta Amigos is a Mexican food operation whose flagship location occupies a colourful floating houseboat in the vibrant community of Fisherman's Wharf in Victoria. The business also runs kiosks at Uptown Mall and the Royal BC Museum courtyard, and operates mobile food trucks for catering. Cyclists exploring the Victoria waterfront can stop here for wraps, burgers, and Mexican street food right at the harbour's edge.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM `floating=yes` tag aligns with the website's description of the Fisherman's Wharf location as a 'colourful floating houseboat,' confirming this record maps to that flagship site. The website is active, lists phone and email contact details, and describes an outdoor waterfront food stand with DoorDash delivery, strongly implying a takeout-oriented format. No bike parking, washroom, water refill, or other cyclist-specific amenity information appears anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM record has no street address or phone number; phone sourced from website only (250 5145362).
Two email addresses appear on the website: info@pvamigos.com (header/footer) and contact@pvamigos.com (contact widget) — minor inconsistency.
This OSM record represents only the Fisherman's Wharf flagship; other locations (Uptown Mall kiosk, Royal BC Museum food truck, mobile food trucks) may warrant separate OSM records.
No street address available — website provides only 'Victoria, BC, Canada' at city level.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active Mexican food operation at Fisherman's Wharf in Victoria; website is live and the business clearly operates at this publicly accessible waterfront location.
